encoded.name: Percent (query)
encoded.note: Form rules: a space becomes '+'. Correct after '?' and wrong inside a path.

encoded.name: Percent (path)
encoded.note: A space becomes %20 and '+' stays a literal '+'. Correct inside a path segment.

encoded.name: Base64 (URL-safe)
encoded.note: Uses '-' and '_' instead of '+' and '/', so it survives being put in a URL.

decoded.name: Percent (query)
decoded.note: '+' is read as a space here.

decoded.name: Percent (path)
decoded.note: '+' is left alone here. Use this reading for a path segment, or for a base64 value.
